const s=$input.first().json;const raw=String(s.output||'').replace(/^esperimentoV[\d.]+\s*[—:\-]?\s*Davide\s*[,.:]?\s*/i,'');const full='esperimentoV0.0.2 — Davide,\n\n'+raw;const chunks=[];for(let i=0;i<full.length;i+=3800)chunks.push({json:{...s,output:full.slice(i,i+3800)},pairedItem:{item:0}});return chunks;
